name: East Asian Home Remedies
summary: Ginger tea, congee, barley tea, yuja-cha and steamed pear from China, Japan and Korea.

remedies.name: Brown Sugar Ginger Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Warm ginger tea is used across China and Korea to settle tummies and warm up after a chill.
steps: Add a little brown sugar and sip.

remedies.name: Okayu / Congee
remedies.howItHelps: Soft rice porridge, what Japanese and Chinese families eat when tummies are upset.
steps: Simmer rice in lots of water for an hour.

remedies.name: Barley Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Roasted barley tea served cold is summer's favourite drink in Japan and Korea.

remedies.name: Yuja-cha
remedies.howItHelps: Korean citron marmalade tea, full of vitamin C, soothes a scratchy throat.
steps: Stir a spoon of yuja marmalade into warm water.

remedies.name: Steamed Pear with Honey
remedies.howItHelps: Pear steamed with honey and jujube is a gentle cough soother in Korea and China.
steps: Grown-up cores a pear and fills it with honey.
Steam until soft and eat it warm.
